Per the file, if we calculate the (per the file) active set at the (per the file) time NewBlock is submitted, the number of nodes to allocate space for is known upfront.

Per the file, if, however, we allow new nodes to vote on old (per the file) blocks, then we'd need (per the file) a way to allocate space dynamically.
